dominant_strengths: Serif/italic 'Oneiro' wordmark paired with warm amber glow creates genuine dream-space mood and emotional warmth
Restrained dark palette with single amber accent feels coherent, premium, and thematically tied to nocturnal subject matter
Feature list has clear hierarchy with iconography, eyebrow label, and sectioning rule that reads cleanly
dominant_weaknesses: No visible primary CTA or progress indicator — onboarding lacks a behavioral next step, hurting task completion
Floating phone-shaped card on empty void feels like a mockup frame, not a native screen, weakening immersion
Three feature icons are generic (clock, zoom, circle) and don't reinforce the dream/symbol concept the copy promises
fix_priorities: Add a prominent amber 'Begin' CTA and pagination dots to make onboarding actionable
Replace generic utility icons with bespoke symbolic glyphs (moon phases, eye, constellation) tied to the brand
Anchor the card to a real device frame or full-bleed background so the composition stops reading as a Figma mock
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral and reflective pull from the dreamy typography and palette, but behavioral layer is underdeveloped without an actionable CTA.
rationale.intent_fit: Communicates the product's emotional promise well but fails as functional onboarding because no forward action is offered.
